In this step of your journey, you deploy the Grafana Kubernetes Monitoring Helm chart. The deployment creates Kubernetes resources such as Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and other objects required to run Grafana in the cluster.

To deploy the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm chart, complete the following steps:

1. In **Deploy Monitoring Resources on the Cluster**, click **Helm**.
1. Turn off **Enable Remote Configuration**.
1. Click the copy icon in the upper-right corner of the Helm chart manifest.
1. Log into the machine where `kubectl` and Helm are installed and configured.
1. Run the copied command from Grafana Cloud in a terminal.

When complete, you should see this message: `Grafana k8s-monitoring Helm chart deployed!`

You can now explore Kubernetes Monitoring dashboards and alerts.

> **Note:** It may take a few minutes for data to appear in your Kubernetes dashboards.
